resources.string: Track holdings and returns in COP or USD.
Investment values are estimates, separate from available cash. COP and USD are never added together.
For existing holdings, enter their cost and current value without changing cash. Do not include this same holding in an account balance. For a new investment, start at zero and add a contribution.
A dated estimate changes the asset value, never your account balance. Zero is a valid valuation.
Enter the cash received and the original cost of the portion sold. The difference is realized gain or loss; the withdrawal is not ordinary income.
Choose the account or pocket used. Link a matching movement if you already recorded the receipt.
Correct the opening values and date. Cash entries and later valuations are kept. The activity history must remain valid.
Original cost of the portion sold
No activity yet. The opening holding does not change cash.
This restores the asset and cash when possible. An imported movement is unlinked and kept. Later activity and reserved funds must remain valid.
Check the amount, date, funding and remaining cost. Available funding must cover a contribution.
Could not save. Check available funds or reload if the investment changed. Your draft is kept.
For PDF, select up to 10,000 movements. Reduce the date range or export CSV.
Only the selected currency, space, period and filters are exported. Capital movements are listed separately from operating totals.
Show amounts to export a report.
Cash already includes savings pockets. This amount excludes debts and receivables.
Could not prepare or share the report. Try again.
